ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, directors, senior management, beneficial owners and authorized signatories against the UN Consolidated Sanctions List, United States OFAC SDN List, European Union consolidated financial sanctions list, and Taiwan domestic designated-persons and terrorist-financing lists. PEP status is a disqualifier unless mitigated by enhanced financial crime due diligence, source-of-wealth verification, and senior-management approval. CDD records must be retained for at least five years after termination of the business relationship; ongoing transaction monitoring is required for the AI API and cryptocurrency payment rails.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: MOEA Company Registration Information System and One-Stop Online Service for Company Name and Business Scope Pre-Approval (onestop.nat.gov.tw)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory company name must be in Traditional Chinese characters. An English name may be registered as a secondary trade name but cannot replace the Chinese statutory name. The Chinese name must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered company, and must not contain simplified Chinese characters or words that would cause the public to mistake the company for a government agency, public utility, or another legal form of company.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Limited Company/有限公司 when not used as the legal form suffix
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The pre-approval certificate is valid for 180 days and may be relied upon only if incorporation is filed before expiry; no automatic extension is available after lapse, so a new application and fee are required. If the name is rejected, the applicant may file a written administrative appeal with MOEA within 30 days from the date of rejection, and further judicial review may be initiated in the Taipei High Administrative Court within two months of the administrative appeal decision. A rejected name cannot be reserved during the appeal period; priority is determined by either a successful reinstatement of the original filing or a fresh filing.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Generally permissible for the registered address and legal correspondence of a non-licensed AI software and API business, provided the Taiwan entity maintains sufficient local substance, including local management, books and records, business premises or demonstrable remote operational capacity, and a registered agent in Taiwan for service of process. A pure letterbox virtual office without real operational activity will be challenged by the Taiwan tax authorities and will not satisfy AML/CFT registration expectations.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low quantified risk: approximately 10-15% annual probability of unannounced inspection for a standard AI/LLM API business with a fully compliant filing history; the likelihood increases to more than 50% where USDC/cryptocurrency payment rails, frequent beneficial-ownership changes, adverse sanctions hits, or inconsistent beneficial-ownership declarations are present.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Taiwan Company Act (公司法), Articles 1, 5, 98, 100, 108, 113, 128, 161 and 387; The Statute for Investment by Chinese Nationals in Taiwan (臺灣地區與大陸地區人民關係條例), Articles 72-73; The Regulations for the Permission of Investment in Taiwan by Chinese Nationals (大陸地區人民來臺投資許可辦法), Articles 4, 6 and 8.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Department of Commercial Affairs, Ministry of Economic Affairs, R.O.C. (Taiwan) (經濟部商業署)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Company Registration Application (公司登記申請書) with certified Articles of Incorporation and Investment Approval Letter for Mainland Chinese Investor.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital applies to a limited company under the Company Act; however, the Investment Commission (MOEA) will screen the proposed capital adequacy for the AI/LLM API business. Paid-up capital must be deposited into a Taiwan-designated bank account in New Taiwan Dollars (NTD) before submission of the company registration; a CPA capital verification report is required if the Articles stipulate a paid-in capital amount.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, by the sole subscriber/shareholder of the company. 1. Adoption: The Articles of Incorporation of the Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise, Ltd. are hereby adopted. 2. Share Subscription: The entire initial capital of NT$[amount] shall be subscribed by the foreign investor and paid into the designated bank account in Taiwan in accordance with the Investment Approval. 3. Registered Office: The principal registered office shall be fixed at [No., Street, District, Taipei City, Taiwan], subject to inspection by the competent authority. 4. Officers: The shareholder appoints [Name] as sole Director and [Name] as Supervisor to hold office until their successors are appointed. 5. Filings: The Director is authorized to complete all statutory registrations, environmental clearances, and open banking accounts. Passed unanimously.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-Investment Approval for Mainland Chinese Investor
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Investment Commission (投資審議委員會), Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taipei
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the Investment Application via the MOEA 'Invest in Taiwan' online portal. Provide the Chinese investor's corporate identity proof, audited financial statements, and a business plan for the Taiwan WFOE (generative AI/LLM API platform). The Investment Commission reviews for compliance with cross-strait restrictions, national security screening, and any prohibited business sectors. Once approved, the Investment Approval Letter will be issued.
required_dossiers: Application Form for Chinese Investment
Business Plan (including the LLM API service model and target market)
Certified corporate registration/business license of the Chinese investor
Audited financial statements of the Chinese investor for the last fiscal year
Board Resolution or sole owner's resolution of the Chinese investor
Power of Attorney for the Taiwan agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Investment Commission issues a supplemental query or preliminary rejection, the applicant may submit supplementary documents within 30 days via the same portal. For formal refusal, a written appeal may be filed with the Executive Yuan within 30 days of receipt of the decision, citing factual or legal grounds.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Taiwan Notary Public or Licensed Attorney (for certification), Ministry of Foreign Affairs for optional authentication
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Company's Articles of Incorporation in Chinese, covering the company’s name, scope of business, capital, shareholder, director, supervisor, and registered office. The sole shareholder (or a holder of a power of attorney) executes the Articles in person before a notary public. Notarization is required for the signatures. If the investment funds exceed NT$10 million, a CPA capital verification step will be added after the bank deposit.
required_dossiers: Drafted Articles of Incorporation
Investment Approval Letter from MOEA
Valid passport or corporate ID of the shareholder and director
Power of Attorney for local agent (if signed abroad, certified by ROC overseas office or notarized per the Foreign Legal Documents Authentication Guidelines)
Bank reference addressing the registered office requirement (if the Articles require any bank confirmation)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the notary identifies discrepancies with the Company Act or the Articles exceed the approved scope, the applicant will be required to amend the Articles and re-execute. A rejection by the notary may be cured by revising the non-compliant clauses and filing a new draft; no additional governmental fee is incurred for the first 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Designated Bank (Foreign Exchange Bank) and Certified Public Accountant
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary NTD capital deposit account under the proposed company's Chinese and English names at a designated foreign exchange bank. Use the Investment Approval Letter to instruct the bank to accept the inward remittance from mainland China, subject to the Central Bank's cross-strait foreign exchange controls. Obtain the bank's capital deposit certificate, then engage a ROC-certified public accountant to prepare a Capital Verification Report where required by the Articles or requested by the registry.
required_dossiers: Investment Approval Letter
Company Name Reservation Certificate (if separately applied)
Bank deposit certificate
Foreign Exchange Remittance Approval from the Central Bank (if triggered)
Capital Verification Report (issued by CPA)
Shareholder's proof of remittance (e.g., SWIFT/cable copy)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Central Bank rejects the remittance for lack of cross-strait capital-flow permits, submit a written explanation to the Investment Commission and the Central Bank with the original approval letter; a revised remittance route through a third-party financial instrument may be accepted after resubmission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Registration with the Ministry of Economic Affairs
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Commercial Affairs (商業署), MOEA – Company Registration One-Stop Service
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the Company Registration Application online via the MOEA one-stop portal (e-service) or at the MOEA office in Taipei. Attach the notarized Articles, Investment Approval Letter, bank capital certificate, CPA report (if any), director/supervisor consent forms, and a lease or ownership certificate for the registered office. Pay the statutory registration fee (based on paid-up capital) and, after review, receive the Company Registration Certificate (公司登記證明書) and a tax-assigned business registration number.
required_dossiers: Company Registration Application Form
Notarized Articles of Incorporation
Investment Approval Letter
Bank Capital Deposit Certificate and CPA report (if applicable)
Director and Supervisor consent letters and identity documents
Registered Office proof (lease or deed, and consent of the landlord)
Name Registration Certificate (valid name reservation)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If MOEA issues a correction notice, the applicant may correct defects within 10 business days and resubmit. In the event of a formal refusal, an administrative appeal may be filed with the Administrative Appeals Committee of MOEA within 30 days of the refusal notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Taxation Administration (財政部賦稅署) – Local District Office, and Bureau of Labor Insurance (勞動部勞工保險局)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After obtaining the Company Registration Certificate, apply for Business Registration and Tax Registration (稅籍登記) with the local National Tax Administration office. The tax authority will issue a Uniform Invoice (統一發票) quota for VAT/ business tax purposes and register the company as a profit-seeking enterprise. Simultaneously, register as an employer with the Bureau of Labor Insurance for labor insurance, pension, and health insurance (NHI) for employees.
required_dossiers: Company Registration Certificate
Articles of Incorporation (certified copy)
Director and supervisor identification documents
Lease agreement or ownership certificate for the registered office
Uniform Invoice Purchase Application
Labor Insurance and National Health Insurance employer registration forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax office requires a physical site inspection for the registered office, present the lease, utility bills, and an interior photograph. If the application is rejected due to missing invoicing seals, reapply after duplicating the company seal and obtain the required invoice stamp.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Operational and Physical Premises Clearances (Office and Cloud Fire Prevention Checks)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Fire Bureau (消防局) and Local Building Administration/Authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: For the office premises, conduct a fire safety inspection and obtain a Fire Safety Certificate (消防安全設備檢修合格證明). If the office houses server equipment or uninterruptible power supplies, a structural load check may be required and the building authority must issue a declaration of lawful use. There is no separate industrial manufacturing permit required for an AI/LLM API platform. If the company owns or physically operates server racks, apply for a low-emission exemption registration with the Environmental Protection Administration.
required_dossiers: Fire safety inspection report (from an approved test facility)
Building use/utilization certificate (usage permit)
Structural load calculation certificate (only when deploying on-premise server equipment)
Environmental exemption registration application (if server equipment is physically held)
Certificate of no hazardous waste generation (for an office-only premise)
Code of Practice for Occupational Safety and Health in the workplace
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the fire inspection reveals fire safety defects, the company must implement the corrective works within a mandatory period and request a re-inspection. For a building code violation, apply for a temporary use license or change of use from the municipal Building Administration. Failure to obtain the Fire Safety Certificate will subject the company to a cease-and-desist order until compliance is confirmed.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs (industrial classification review; not applicable for this AI/LLM API platform)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No sector-specific operating license required; general business registration under the Company Act and the Business Taxation Act suffices

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Administration (行政院環境保護署), R.O.C. (Taiwan)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – Registration only; the GPT/LLM API platform is an office-based software activity with no manufacturing plant or stationary emission source; an Environmental Exemption Registration is required only if the company physically operates on-premise server racks (data center standards may apply).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable for facility discharge; however, if server equipment is installed, the data center must comply with the Air Pollution Control Act for diesel generator standby emissions (if any) and the Waste Management Act for electronic waste recycling of IT components; no VOC or wastewater discharge thresholds apply for pure software operations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate under the Fire Services Act (消防安全設備檢修), building structural load occupancy clearance from the local Building Administration, and an Occupational Safety and Health compliance check for office workstations under the Occupational Safety and Health Act; a Labor Insurance employer registration is required for all employees.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) of the People's Republic of China, official portal https://www.chinatax.gov.cn/
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign-invested enterprises such as WFOEs obtain tax identification through simultaneous registration with the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR). The statutory TIN is the Unified Social Credit Code (USCC), issued upon approval of the business license.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box elections available in China. However, hybrid mismatch election rules apply under the Base Erosion and Profit Shifting (BEPS) Action 2 framework for certain cross-border transactions.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: RMB 500,000 in annual taxable turnover for general VAT registration (small-scale taxpayers have lower thresholds and rates)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time electronic invoicing and tax clearance via the National Tax Administration's Electronic Invoice System (EIS) and Tax Control System (TCS). Large taxpayers must integrate with API for automatic reporting and digital invoice stamping.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Eligibility for 0% VAT rate on exported goods and offshore services requires proof of actual export, foreign currency repatriation, and compliance with customs procedures.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Inward Remittance Certificate (IRC) or equivalent proof of foreign exchange repatriation
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent claims result in penalties of up to three times the evaded tax, interest charges, and potential criminal prosecution. Retrospective clawback of VAT refunds if export verification fails or documentation is incomplete.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: The People's Bank of China (PBOC) and the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE); for Taiwan-origin investment, Taiwan's Central Bank and the MOEA Investment Commission also regulate the investor's outflow side.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: RMB is convertible for current-account transactions (AI/LLM API licensing fees, cloud usage, software exports) after the domestic bank verifies the contract, invoice and tax filing where required. Capital-account transactions remain controlled: FDI paid-in capital, intercompany loans, equity transfers and foreign guarantees require SAFE registration or approval. Profit remittance to the Taiwanese shareholder is treated as current-account investment income and is legally remittable after the WFOE completes statutory audit, final CIT settlement, withholding tax payment, and provides the bank with a board resolution, audited distributable-reserves computation and SAFE remittance form.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: China no longer imposes mandatory export surrender ratios or fixed forced-conversion quotas on export receipts. Export and service-trade proceeds must be collected into the WFOE's domestic foreign-currency account and supported by underlying trade/commercial documentation; the WFOE may retain or voluntarily sell the FX to a domestic bank. SAFE uses an A/B/C compliance classification for trade-related flows: an A-class enterprise enjoys automatic settlement and conversion, while B/C classification triggers a 90-day enhanced verification window, restricted foreign-currency account operation and stricter documentary review.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: FDI Capital Account for inbound equity plus general operating RMB/foreign-currency settlement account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited (ICBC)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational RMB basic account, foreign-currency settlement account and cross-border e-banking package
RMB basic deposit account and current-account foreign exchange settlement account
Corporate virtual account and cross-border service-trade settlement account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low for statutory treasury functions. Offshore digital EMIs cannot open the WFOE's statutory FDI capital account or serve as the primary SAFE-reported collection bank. They are feasible only as a secondary API-revenue collection gateway when they route through a licensed PRC bank, retain full audit trails and do not hold the WFOE's export receivables offshore. Crypto/USDC settlement rails are not a recognized corporate clearing system in China; crypto can be used only after conversion into fiat through licensed on/off-ramps and must be excluded from equity and trade-payment flows.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Tier-1 PRC banks generally require at least one physical branch visit by the legal representative or jointly authorized director during account opening. Remote video verification is sometimes accepted for supplementary KYC, but not as a complete substitute for the in-person interview and address-confirmation of the WFOE. The Taiwanese investor should execute a board resolution, list at least one locally resident finance signatory, and have original company chops, notarized certificates and passport copies available for the bank's compliance review.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial-ownership opacity arising from the Taiwan holding chain
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Updated corporate registry and cap-table, notarized UBO declaration, source-of-funds statement, audited financial statements of the Taiwan shareholder, SAFE/MOFCOM foreign-investment registration, and legal-entity identifiers of each intermediate holding company.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: AI/LLM API platform treated as an export-control and cross-border data-transfer sensitive activity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commercial service/software agreements, PIPL-compliant data-processing map, an internal export-control classification memo, records confirming no sanctioned or restricted end-users, and the WFOE's business license scope covering computer programming and related software services.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High transaction velocity expected from Stripe card acquiring and USDC settlement patterns
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Customer onboarding/KYC logs, transaction-monitoring policy, API sales dashboard, treasury instructions confirming no direct crypto-in/crypto-out in the corporate bank account, and a written reconciliation policy for chargebacks, refunds and prepaids.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing for equity capital: (1) obtain MOFCOM/AMR foreign-investment filing and SAFE FDI registration for the WFOE; (2) the Taiwanese shareholder shall file with Taiwan's MOEA Investment Commission if applicable; (3) execute a SWIFT MT103 from the Taiwan corporate bank to the WFOE's designated FDI capital account, quoting the bank-mapped SAFE BOP code for 'foreign direct investment capital contribution' plus the FDI registration number; (4) instruct the receiving bank not to commingle the remittance with operating revenue; (5) for each RMB settlement out of the capital account, provide a capital-account income payment instruction sheet, supporting invoices/contracts, and identify the exact purpose; (6) RMB injections can flow via CIPS with the same purpose annotation; cryptocurrency/USDC is not acceptable for equity capital injection.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Use SWIFT MT103 for AI/LLM API licensing fees, cloud infrastructure payments and subcontractor disbursements after submitting the contract, invoice, tax withholding certificate and the applicable SAFE service-trade BOP code to the PRC bank. For workstation/GPU procurement, use sight documentary credits (L/C at sight) with full shipping documents through a confirming bank, or MT202 for counterparty bank transfers under an underlying master agreement. RMB trade payments should be cleared through CIPS with a compliant service-trade purpose annotation; USD/EUR flows clear via CHIPS/Fedwire/TARGET2 correspondent banks. USDC/crypto cannot be used as a corporate clearing rail for outbound trade settlement.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable RMB/USD forward contracts booked with a licensed PRC bank under SAFE 'real transaction background' verification
Foreign exchange swaps and cross-currency swaps between RMB and USD for working capital, intercompany loan and cash-flow hedging
RMB/USD FX option strategies (zero-cost collars, buying puts/calls) with direct trade or investment exposure
Offshore RMB/USD NDFs are permissible only at the Taiwanese parent or offshore treasury centre level; the onshore WFOE should not book offshore NDFs directly
SAFE-registered forward settlement and sales arrangements for documented service-trade receivables and dividend remittance projections

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory incentives include: (a) R&D investment credit up to 15% of qualifying R&D expenditure under Article 10 of the Statute for Industrial Innovation, offsettable against current-year profit-seeking enterprise income tax with a four-year carryforward for unused credits; (b) accelerated expensing under Article 10-1 for smart machinery and 5G equipment where applicable; (c) no automatic AI-specific tax holiday, but the WFOE remains eligible for general industrial innovation credits if approved; (d) retained earnings surtax at 5% is imposed on undistributed earnings, which can be avoided by timely dividend distribution.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Profit-seeking Enterprise Income Tax Return (Form: 營利事業所得稅結算申報書) filed electronically through the Ministry of Finance National Taxation Bureau's e-申报 system (電子申報繳稅服務網) at tax.nat.gov.tw, using approved e-Filing software and a valid digital certificate or tax representative authorization.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The return and self-assessment payment are due on the last day of the fifth month following the fiscal year-end; a calendar-year WFOE must file by 31 May, unless a special fiscal year has been approved by the tax authority.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: WFOE legal name, Unified Business Number (UBN), registered address, business commencement date, and principal place of business; for a Taiwan-incorporated WFOE, the tax resident status is Taiwanese domestic.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the Taiwan WFOE's own UBN and Taiwan address; do not insert the non-resident parent's tax ID in this box except when providing parent information in the controlled-transaction annexes.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2 - Gross Revenue and Revenue Type
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total operating revenue from AI/LLM API token sales, inference subscription fees, platform usage licences, and related services; include both domestic and foreign-source gross revenue attributable to the Taiwan PE.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report all revenue attributable to the Taiwan WFOE's operations, including sales made through Stripe or USDC payment rails; foreign-source revenue is taxable if the WFOE is a Taiwan resident enterprise, with foreign tax credit applied separately.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 3 - Cost of Inference and Cost of Goods Sold
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cloud computing infrastructure, GPU hosting, model serving, token inference costs, data centre fees, software licensing for AI model components, and direct depreciation of hardware allocated to the AI API service.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only include costs actually borne by the Taiwan WFOE; recharges from the foreign parent must be supported by arm's length transfer pricing documentation and should not simply mirror head-office allocations.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Salaries, R&D labour, marketing and sales costs, maintenance, rent, office overhead, royalties, management fees, and professional services related to the AI LLM API platform.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Intercompany royalties and management fees paid to the non-resident parent must be deducted only if they satisfy genuine service, economic substance, and the withholding tax requirements; failure to withhold will render a portion non-deductible and subject the payer to penalty.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Interest income, foreign exchange gains or losses, dividend income, disposal gains on assets, and other non-sales income/expenses; include provisions for foreign taxes and any penalty disallowances.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report worldwide income as a Taiwan resident profit-seeking enterprise; calculate foreign tax credit on an income-source basis; characterise all transactions with the non-resident parent accurately, including crypto-denominated interest.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 6 - Tax-Exempt Income and Loss Carryforward
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductions for tax-exempt income (e.g., certain overseas investment income) and deduction of prior years' net operating losses in accordance with the ten-year carryforward rule.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Loss carryforward is available only if the WFOE maintained complete accounting records and prepared certified annual financial reports; for a WFOE, the NOL deduction is limited to its own Taiwanese-source and worldwide taxable income, with no group relief.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 7 - Taxable Income and Alternative Minimum Tax
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computation of assessable income after all adjustments, application of the 20% statutory rate, and calculation of the Alternative Minimum Tax (AMT) at 12% if certain preferential items result in an effective tax rate below the AMT threshold.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The AMT base includes intercompany royalties, interest, and tax-holiday-exempt income; a comprehensive TP report must justify the allocation or the AMT is assessed on adjustments.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 8 - Tax Credits and Net Tax Payable
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Application of R&D investment credits, foreign tax credits, minimum-government-investment credits, and any approved investment tax incentives; the resulting net corporate income tax payable or refundable is then carried to the payment settlement line.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The WFOE may claim foreign tax credits for taxes paid on foreign-source income; withholding taxes borne by the foreign parent on inbound royalties or dividends are not creditable on the WFOE's own return and must be reimbursed separately under DTA if applicable.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: For late filing without extension: a fixed penalty of NT$1,500 if no tax is due; if tax is due, a surcharge of 10% of the assessed tax under Article 108 of the Income Tax Act. For late payment: a surcharge of 1% of the unpaid tax for every two days, capped at 10% of the unpaid amount, plus default interest at the inflation-adjusted one-year postal savings rate. Intentional understatement or evasion may trigger an additional penalty of up to two times the evaded tax under Article 110 and criminal referral under Article 41 of the Tax Collection Act.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 21% final withholding tax on dividends paid by a Taiwan resident profit-seeking enterprise to a non-resident corporate shareholder; this rate applies to a Mainland China parent in the absence of an effective Cross-Strait Double Taxation Agreement.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Where a bilateral tax agreement (DTA) is in force, the non-resident shareholder must obtain a Certificate of Residence (TRC) from its home tax authority and submit an application for reduced withholding to the Taiwan National Taxation Bureau before the dividend distribution date. The payer may withhold at the reduced treaty rate after issuance of a tax authority acknowledgement; otherwise, the excess WHT may be reclaimed through a subsequent refund application. For Mainland China, the Cross-Strait Tax Agreement signed on 25 August 2015 is not yet in force; consequently, no treaty relief is currentlyavailable and no TRC-based refund may be sought under that agreement.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding rates are 20% for royalties paid to non-residents and 20% for interest paid to non-residents, with a 15% rate for certain short-term commercial paper interest. Under Taiwan's effective DTAs, treaty rates often reduce royalties and interest to 10%; however, no reduction applies for Mainland China before the Cross-Strait Tax Agreement enters into force.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: A Taiwan WFOE is required to prepare and submit transfer pricing documentation (the Local File) if its aggregate controlled transactions with related parties exceed TWD 50 million in the tax year; the Master File is required for a multinational group with consolidated annual revenue above TWD 27 billion, along with the prescribed administrative thresholds for controlled services and intangibles. Even when below the explicit threshold, contemporaneous documentation is recommended for all intercompany AI/LLM licensing, cloud cost recharges, and derivative revenue allocations.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Taiwan does not apply Caribbean-style Economic Substance Regulations, but it applies an economic substance principle through the General Anti-Avoidance Rule (Article 12-1 of the Income Tax Act), Article 43-1 on controlled-transaction adjustment, and the domestic/foreign income anti-abuse rules. A Taiwan WFOE deriving AI/LLM API revenue must maintain real employees, active decision-making, risk bearing, core intellectual property ownership, and independent profit ability in Taiwan. If the WFOE is recharacterized as a shell or conduit, the tax authority may ignore the separate existence, reallocate income to or from the non-resident parent, impose Article 43-1 adjustments, deny deductible intercompany payments, and apply the 21% withholding tax to any deemed dividend distribution.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately omitting or misstating AI/LLM API revenue generated through USDC or offshore payment rails; fabricating cloud-computing or inference-related expenses; executing artificial intra-group pricing to shift profit away from Taiwan; or retaining false invoices and sham service contracts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Article 110 of the Income Tax Act, the tax authority imposes a surcharge of up to two times the evaded tax; moreover, Article 41 of the Tax Collection Act criminalizes fraudulent tax evasion with imprisonment of up to five years, short-term detention, and/or a fine. The evaded tax plus default interest is collectible, and the WFOE may lose the benefit of any incentive credits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false returns or knowingly participate in the evasion are jointly and severally liable in civil proceedings for the restored tax and penalties; the tax authority may impose a travel ban under Article 23-1 of the Tax Collection Act when the tax debt exceeds the statutory threshold; criminal conviction may result in imprisonment and disqualification from serving as a director.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and Economic Substance Abuse
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the CN_WFOE_LTD as a nominally registered Taiwan company without meaningful staff, physical office, business risk, or decision authority; entering intercompany contracts that are the financial statement equivalent to paper transfer-pricing; using the WFOE as a conduit to strip Taiwan-generated AI API profits to a non-resident parent or a tax-haven affiliate.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Article 43-1 of the Income Tax Act, the tax authority may recharacterize and price the related-party transactions at arm's length; the General Anti-Avoidance Rule under Article 12-1 permits disregarding the arrangement and taxing the economic substance. The resulting additional tax is subject to a penalty of up to two times, with possible denial of all intercompany deductions and the reclassification of the repatriated payments as taxable dividends.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and controlling officers face personal liability if the shell structure is used to evade corporate tax; they may be ordered to pay civil restitution of the tax, penalties, and interest; the tax authority may obtain a court order for civil recovery, impose a travel ban, and, in aggravated cases, prosecute for tax fraud leading to imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting USDC or other cryptocurrency payments from clients without applying customer due diligence, without recording transaction information, and without reporting suspicious transactions; integrating illicit proceeds through the AI API platform; or carrying on unregistered virtual asset exchange activity beyond the mere acceptance of crypto for service fees.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Money Laundering Control Act, a non-compliant institution is liable for administrative fines of NT$1 million to NT$5 million for each violation; if the funds are derived from criminal conduct, Article 14 imposes money-laundering liability of up to seven years' imprisonment and a fine not exceeding NT$5 million, with forfeiture of the laundered property.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and AML compliance officers are personally subject to administrative penalties and may be disqualified from management; they can face civil monetary penalties and restitution for funds laundered through the platform; an ongoing AML investigation may trigger bail restrictions, travel bans, and ultimately criminal conviction with imprisonment.
